title: Coffee for Teleshko

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I am busy, citizen. And in no mood for idle chat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am busy, citizen. And in no mood for idle chat.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Correct. I am glad to see you taking on a new line of work. If only more citizens had your zeal for business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Correct. I am glad to see you taking on a new line of work. If only more citizens had your zeal for business.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: An accurate if irritating observation. Well? Do you intend to impede my progress all day?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An accurate if irritating observation. Well? Do you intend to impede my progress all day?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: A what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A what?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Favors are in direct violation of this sector’s Profitability Enhancement Directives.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Favors are in direct violation of this sector’s Profitability Enhancement Directives.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Charge a fee for your deliveries from now on, or face a fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Charge a fee for your deliveries from now on, or face a fine.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Hmph. Good day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmph. Good day.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Quite. And I thank you for delivering mine. These penalty fees don't issue themselves. Good day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Quite. And I thank you for delivering mine. These penalty fees don't issue themselves. Good day.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Then deliver it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then deliver it.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You think I would order something so inefficient?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I would order something so inefficient?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Did you simply come here to insult me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you simply come here to insult me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like somebody needs their coffee!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like somebody needs their coffee!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like somebody needs their coffee!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like somebody needs their coffee!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have your coffee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have your coffee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I'm here to deliver your coffee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I'm here to deliver your coffee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I'm here to deliver your coffee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I'm here to deliver your coffee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually, I’m doing it as a favor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually, I’m doing it as a favor.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Actually, I’m doing it as a favor.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Actually, I’m doing it as a favor.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Caffeine is the fuel that drives the engine of commerce.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Caffeine is the fuel that drives the engine of commerce.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Caffeine is the fuel that drives the engine of commerce.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Caffeine is the fuel that drives the engine of commerce.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nevermind. Enjoy the coffee!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nevermind. Enjoy the coffee!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A favor. It’s when you do something to help someone else out because you can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A favor. It’s when you do something to help someone else out because you can.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A favor. It’s when you do something to help someone else out because you can.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A favor. It’s when you do something to help someone else out because you can.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you saying?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really are a psychopath.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really are a psychopath.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course, Agent Teleshko.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course, Agent Teleshko.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: One Extra Extra Tall Grande Latte.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One Extra Extra Tall Grande Latte.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: One Extra Extra Tall Grande Latte.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: One Extra Extra Tall Grande Latte.

nodes.text: Here's your Dark Roast Tuna Combo.
